scope: Static inspection and six new synthetic selection-audit boundary cases only. No teacher generation, model fitting, private arrays, old heldout, or sealed evaluation read. Parent runs changed-path tests separately.

resolved_findings.initial: Rescue arrays were copied and hashed but not independently selection-consistency audited.
resolved_findings.resolution: fit_audit invokes audit_rescue_selection on original V; recomputes all128 residuals, rejects negative losses/nonunit candidates, then rebuilds argsort/threshold/duplicate selection and requires exact64 array equality. Existing final retained residual/norm/duplicate checks remain.
resolved_findings.evidence: probe-repaired-results.json: valid synthetic accepted; five adversarial cases rejected including nonexistent retained64th and65th not truncated.

resolved_findings.initial: Readiness approved review could refer to different sources or registration.
resolved_findings.resolution: require_readiness requires review.sources==sources() and review.registration_sha256==REG_SHA before committed-byte checks.

positive_boundaries: Fresh entropy occurs after readiness; committed registration/source/certificate/review bytes are checked.
Learner and selector argv/env receive public path only, fixed frozen rescue script.
63/64 branching refuses other counts; exclusive learner/selection attempt markers prohibit retry.
64 branch preserves exact base bytes and rejects rescue directory.
Verify creates consumed marker before any read; all private reads occur in verifier only.
No truncation of extra rescue candidates; exactly64 required.
Actual retained residual/norm/duplicate checks use original Hessian subspace.
Teacher parent monitors all stage descendants with180s/512MiB outer budget.
Per-teacher error is preserved as failure, aggregate requires all3pass.
Full-map thresholds/access/query count/teacher distribution preserved fromv2.
approval_conditions: Commit exact reviewed sources/registration/review and matching readiness before any entropy, private directory creation or fresh teacher generation. Runtime gate independently enforces committed-byte equality.
Parent changed-path tests, strict type check and lint must pass before running fresh experiment. This review does not claim their outcome.
Use three entirely fresh owned teachers; do not reuse any v1/v2 truth or heldout labels.
Keep v2 overall FAILED63/64/64 unchanged; v3 only passes if all preregistered criteria on all three teachers pass.
limitations: Logical process separation under same OS account, not an adversarial sandbox.
Saved candidate residuals are numerical, finiteprecision diagnostics;64 candidates do not independently prove true coverage.
Audit does not replay GN optimization or derive all initialization eigenvectors; frozen source and process execution commitments provide method provenance.
Process RSS is sampled rather than reserved/continuously measured.
Protocol concerns owned isolated bias-free continuous-query GLU blocks, not final-text APIs, whole Transformers, originalU/D values or universal model reconstruction.
